name: Your Company
tagline: Classic furniture for bedrooms and living rooms

listing.description: A website for a classic furniture salon: suite cards with a spec sheet, a price list of separate pieces, slow frames and an order form sent to Telegram.

seo.title: Your Company — classic bedroom and living room furniture
seo.description: Classic bedrooms and living rooms in solid walnut and beech: suites from 24,000,000 UZS, separate pieces, wedding sets. Salon on Amir Temur Ave.
seo.answer: Your Company is a classic furniture salon in Tashkent (107 Amir Temur Ave). Solid-wood bedroom suites from 24,000,000 UZS, living rooms from 31,000,000 UZS, made to order in 30–45 days. Delivery and assembly across Tashkent are free; 3-year warranty on solid wood.

sections.title: Furniture you pass on to your children
sections.subtitle: Bedrooms and living rooms in solid walnut and beech with hand carving and patina. We assemble a set for your room and deliver in 30–45 days.

sections.label: The salon
sections.title: Hand carving, assembly with not a single nail in sight
sections.text: Our factory in Chirchik has worked since 2011: we dry the timber ourselves, carve by hand and finish with six coats of lacquer. Six complete suites stand in the Amir Temur salon — you can lie on a bed and open every drawer.

items.title: The Venezia bedroom
items.text: A bed with a carved headboard, two nightstands, a chest with a mirror and a six-door wardrobe.

items.title: The Shirin bedroom
items.text: Light patina, an upholstered headboard and a dressing table for the bride.

items.title: The Registan living room
items.text: A sofa and two armchairs in jacquard, a china cabinet and a coffee table.

items.title: The Dastarkhan dining room
items.text: An extendable table for 12 and chairs with carved backs.

sections.title: What it looks like in real life

items.title: Choose in the salon

items.text: We check the wardrobe fits through the door and into the niche.

items.title: Delivery and assembly
items.text: Free in Tashkent; to the regions at the carrier’s rate.

items.q: Can I buy a single piece from a suite?
items.a: Yes, every piece is sold separately at the list price.
